body.p: There were three little girls who lived in a little house. One of them saw a Mink coming. The Mink said, "Girls, there is a big man coming;" and these little girls were afraid, and ran into the house and told their grandmother; and their grandmother said, "Girls, run into the woods!" So they ran into the woods; and the big man came up and said, "Mink, where are the girls?" and the Mink did not answer. And the big man said, "Mink, I will kill you!" and the Mink ran into the woods.
